question: Are my files safe on PDFIndi?
answer:
Yes, your files are completely safe! We take data security and privacy very seriously:

  • 🔒 Secure Processing: All file uploads and processing use HTTPS encryption
  • 🗑️ Automatic Deletion: Files are automatically deleted from our servers within minutes after processing
  • 🚫 No Permanent Storage: We do not keep copies of your documents
  • 👁️ No Access: Your files are never viewed, accessed, or shared with third parties
  • India-Based Servers: Data processed on Indian servers for better security and compliance
  • 🔐 Client-Side Processing: Many tools process files directly in your browser without uploading

For more details, please read our Privacy Policy.
